question: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment has launched India’s first pan-India helpline for senior citizens named ________ for which the toll-free number is 14567.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Elder Line.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first toll-free helpline for senior citizens** in all of India is the** Elder Line (14567).**
 
• It was introduced by the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.**
 
• The** Longitudinal Ageing Study of India** predicts that by** 2050, **there would be over **319 million senior people **in India, up from the current** 120 million.**
 
• The older population has a variety o**f difficulties, including psychological, financial, emotional, physical, and legal ones.**
 
• Elder Line provides** free information, guidance, emotional support, and field intervention in cases of abuse & rescues** in order to improve the quality of life of senior citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SAGE (Seniorcare Aging Growth Engine) initiative:**

 
 
• ​The SAGE was introduced by the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.**
 
• The SAGE portal will provide **"one-stop access" to reputable start-ups'** senior care goods and services.
 
• It was started with the intention of** assisting **those people who are interested in **starting their own business offering services** for elderly care.
 
• The SAGE initiative intends to **locate, assess, confirm, compile, and distribute goods, services**, and solutions to the stakeholders.
